risk_if_not_implemented: Without Entropy Source & Random Bit Generation, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Cryptographic Key Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.
compensating_control_1.justification: Cryptographic Key Management (CRY-10) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Entropy Source & Random Bit Generation (QTS-09.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_2.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration and supply-chain hardening that compensates for the absence of Entropy Source & Random Bit Generation (QTS-09.1) by enforcing secure settings and trusted software sources to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
